instruction.name: xvssrlni.h.w
instruction.description: Logical right shift the unsigned 32-bit elements in `a` and `b` by `imm`, saturate the result to signed 16-bit, write the 16-bit result into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvssrlni.h.w $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvssrlni.h.w $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvssrlni.h.w $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvssrlni.h.w $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvssrlni.h.w $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvssrlni.h.w $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvssrlni.h.w $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvssrlni.h.w $xr7, $xr15, 1
